title: Unit Event — Halt! Tenma's on the Case — Episode3 The Show Can't Go On?!

meta.Episode: Episode3 — The Show Can't Go On?!
meta.Event Outline: At Kijima's suggestion, Tsukasa has been putting on muscle to increase his acting chops. He and the others arrive at the Jidaigeki Studio Park with the Mikazukigumi troupe, but news of a theft puts the new production on hold...and that's when Tsukasa spots a suspicious ninja on the lot!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wh-Wh-Wh-Whaaaaaat?!?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Our performances might get canceled starting today?! I-Is that true?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
N-Not sure...
I just happened to overhear some people saying that while walking by the warehouse...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Canceled?!
I don't want that to happen!!! We practiced so much for it!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
...
Let's all take a deep breath first.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: There haven't been any official announcements yet. We'd be hearing about it from Mr. Kijima if something as serious as that were to occur.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So for now, let's keep preparing for the next showing.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Y-Yes, you're right...!
These are the moments when we need to stay strong...
se_walk_men_003_1

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Sorry to do this all of a sudden, but I need everyone to gather up.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
...!
Mr. Kijima!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Looks like we get to hear the news right away...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Some of you may've already gotten wind of this...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Until further notice, we won't be doing any more performances starting today.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I-It's really happening...!
Those people were right...

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line: Why are they getting canceled?!

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line:
You said “until further notice.”
Does that mean there's a possibility of us resuming?

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
No, not at the moment.
The reason behind this cancellation is rather serious...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: May we ask what that reason is...?

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: The Jidaigeki Studio Park has been faced with a string of thefts recently.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Th-Thefts?!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Mostly involving people's belongings disappearing after being placed down somewhere. Everything from their bags to souvenirs they bought here.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: The most recent incidents apparently involve directly stealing from the souvenir shops, probably because the other thefts have gone well. The park staff has been patrolling around and warning guests, but they've yet to catch whoever's responsible...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Th-That's terrible!
Who would steal the guests' valuables like that?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Unacceptable! It's pure cowardice...!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Yeah, I feel the same way...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: But first, we need to talk about our show.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: The park decided that it's not a good idea to let it continue since it's about catching a thief.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: So, we won't be doing any further performances until we see a cease in these thefts.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Which means this could be it for us...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Excuse me, Mr. Kijima?!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Yes, Otori?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I understand that we're probably supposed to keep practicing until whoever's behind these thefts is caught...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But would it be possible for us to use some of that time to put on performances warning the guests about what's been going on?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? So, we'd be warning them to be careful...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Excellent idea...!
In other words, we'd be raising guests' level of awareness through street performances!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! They're here to smile and have fun, but having your things taken is always really sad...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Which is why I thought it'd be good for us to warn everyone about these thefts!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. It's very like you to suggest an idea such as this, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Not performing means having a lot of free time on our hands.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Let's go ask the park to see if they'll accommodate your idea. I have a feeling that they will since they also feel compelled to warn all the guests.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yay!
Thank you so much!!!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: I know you're all feeling disappointed about this situation...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
But we haven't been canceled outright.
So, let's try to stay positive.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Right...!!!
The next day
Hiori Jidaigeki Studio Park - Main Street

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “Did you all hear?!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “A string of thefts has been occurring here lately!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
“Huh? Thefts?
That's so scary! What's been getting stolen...?”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “Apparently, people's belongings after they put them down for a second. They're there one second and gone the next!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “So, everyone's gotta keep a close eye on their bags and wallets!”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “We suggest you report any suspicious activity you see to the locals wearing name tags.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Yes, and don't be afraid! The famed constable and his right-hand man will come to your aid!”

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: They're staying in character while telling us all this, but I guess the rumors were true about people's things disappearing...

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: Yeah, we gotta be careful.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Okay...
They're responding well to our warning.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I hope this helps remedy the situation a bit.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (That being said...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Us not being able to perform because of these thefts is beyond infuriating!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I want whoever's behind them to get caught so that we can resume.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Alright, we've just about covered this area.
Why don't we try around the tea shop next?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Okay!
Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Tsukasa? What's wrong?
Aren't you gonna come to the tea shop with us?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm?!
Oh, sorry! I was just thinking to myself!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Let's hurry over to our next stop.
At the tea shop, Rui, you're going to steal Emu's dango and I'm going to catch you, yes?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, our goal for this scene is to heighten everyone's senses by presenting them with a realistic theft.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Then, we should get our dango props ready... Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry...
I think I left them in the warehouse.
Gimme a second to go grab them.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, in that case, I'll go instead.
You three wait here in the meantime.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! My speed has increased greatly because of my training. It'll only take me a second to retrieve them from the warehouse!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks. Then, if you don't mind...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course! I'll be right back!
Warehouse

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm... The props should be somewhere around here...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's nice that the park's allowing us to store things in one of their warehouses, but it's hard to remember where anything is because it's so massive.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I could've sworn that we left them... Ah, here we are!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, back to the tea shop...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I thought I heard someone else just now...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Was it one of the troupe members? Or the park staff...? In any case, I should go greet them.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (That sound came from over here. Alright...)
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hello!
Hm...?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wh-What the...?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Th-This man's dressed as a ninja...!
And he's carrying a prop pot! But he's frozen completely solid...!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Th-This is far too suspicious...!
He's neither a member of Mikazukigumi nor does he appear to have a staff badge.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (As far as I can tell, he's just a thief dressed as...)
se_event_torimonothou_2024_003

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(H-He's running!
Which means...!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thief!!!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Halt, you coward! Stop right there!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I was startled at first, but now I'm on his tail!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Tsukasa Tenma is going to get this collar!!!!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You're wanted for arrest!!!!
